description: This file implements the 'Selectors' class which manages selector engines, test ID attributes, and related functionalities within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for registering custom selector engines, setting test ID attributes, and handling internal selector options.

classes.name: Selectors
classes.description: Manages custom selector engines and test ID attributes, facilitating their registration and configuration in play context.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Selectors instance with a specified platform.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new selector engine with a given name and source script or function, optionally specifying if it's a content script.

methods.name: setTestIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the attribute name used for test IDs and updates existing contexts accordingly.

methods.name: _withSelectorOptions
methods.description: Generates an options object including current selector engines and test ID attribute, used internally.

ctags.name: source
ctags.pattern: /^    const source = await evaluationScript(this._platform, script, undefined, false);$/
